summary.name: Ihor Medvediev
summary.description: I am an experienced IT professional with a strong background in analytical problem-solving. I am a full-stack developer with knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js. I have completed all my projects using the Agile/Scrum methodology and strictly adhering to deadlines. I have excellent interpersonal skills and take a proactive approach to solving problems. I am a fast learner, responsible, and always ready for new challenges. I am looking for opportunities to contribute to a dynamic and innovative IT team.

education.title: A FEW WORDS ABOUT ME
education.motivation: Your determination and perseverance define your future. Never give up!
education.description: Hello everyone, my name is Igor. I’m from Kyiv, Ukraine. Currently, I live and work at Vysočinské nemocnice in Humpolec, Czech Republic, where I’ve been for the past 4 years. I graduated from Medical University in 2012 and started my medical career shortly after. However, in 2021, I developed an interest in single-page website development. Realizing I needed more structured knowledge, I took a course in HTML/CSS. What began as a hobby quickly became a passion and guided my decision on my future tech stack. I then completed a year-long Full-Stack Developer course from January 20, 2023, to February 14, 2024, and will receive a certificate. At the moment, I have more than a year of practice and have 8 projects in my portfolio, both team and individual.
